sections.heading: Definitions
sections.guidance: Define each defined term used elsewhere in the agreement.

sections.heading: Commitment
sections.guidance: State the lender's commitment to lend and the borrower's right to cancel it.

sections.heading: Interest
sections.guidance: State how interest is calculated and paid.

sections.heading: Repayment
sections.guidance: State when and how the loan is repaid.

sections.heading: Undertakings
sections.guidance: State what the borrower must do and must not do while the facility is outstanding.

sections.heading: Events of Default
sections.guidance: State the lender's powers on default and when a default is deemed to occur.
